title: Carshalton Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical hubs, river flood risks, and critical resource corridors for Carshalton (SM5).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA. Travel guidance: from Carshalton station, ~20 min walk north along North Street and Green Wrythe Lane, or take bus 157 or 151 directly to the hospital entrance. For major trauma care, St George's Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Blackshaw Road, Tooting SW17 0QT. Travel guidance: from Carshalton station, take Govia Thameslink train to Tooting, or bus 157 towards Morden connecting to Northern line. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: St Helier Urgent Treatment Centre, ground floor B-block at St Helier Hospital, Wrythe Lane, Carshalton SM5 1AA (handles minor injuries and illnesses 24/7). 3. Area Hazards: River Wandle flood plain (Carshalton Ponds, The Grove, and Wilderness Island corridors) with risk of flash flooding and road impassability along North Street and Mill Lane during extreme rainfall. 4. Essential Supplies: Pharmacies and grocery stores along Carshalton High Street, Beacon Grove, and around Carshalton Beeches (Banstead Road) provide emergency clean water, basic medical provisions, and supplies during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
